title: Local representation width for PNN-v1
research_question: Does alpha1 lose useful ECG information by compressing each eight-sample local window to only four Fourier/KAN features?
hypothesis: The 8->4 local mapping is an information bottleneck. Increasing only the number of learned local Fourier/KAN features can improve validation accuracy without the instability introduced by additional depth.
frozen_candidates: alpha1_w4: 12 local 8->4 blocks, concatenate 48, Fourier/KAN 48->2 head
alpha1_w6: 12 local 8->6 blocks, concatenate 72, Fourier/KAN 72->2 head
alpha1_w8: 12 local 8->8 blocks, concatenate 96, Fourier/KAN 96->2 head

data_protocol.selection_rule: Reuse the exact deterministic stratified TRAIN/validation boundary from Exp003 and Exp004. Compare the three frozen widths across the same 10 fixed seeds. Select by highest mean validation Q.ANT accuracy; if tied, choose lower validation standard deviation; if still tied, choose fewer parameters. Freeze selection before canonical TEST evaluation.
data_protocol.test_boundary: Canonical TEST must not influence width selection.

design_constraints: Keep a single local Fourier/KAN stage followed directly by one Fourier/KAN classifier head.
Change only local feature width: 4, 6, or 8.
No residual path and no second mixer stage.
primary_metric: Mean validation Q.ANT accuracy across the 10 fixed seeds.
secondary_metrics: canonical TEST accuracy after selection is frozen
success_criteria: The selected wider candidate (w6 or w8) must exceed alpha1_w4 mean validation Q.ANT accuracy by at least 0.02 absolute and have validation Q.ANT standard deviation no more than 0.01 absolute above alpha1_w4. Otherwise alpha1_w4 remains the active architecture.
hardware_boundary: Software/simulation-backend experiment only; no real photonic hardware performance claim.
next_gate: Implement and review PNN-v1 Exp005, then add it to the guarded approval allowlist.
